basis: Unchanged exact endpoint-sign predictor derived on ranks 1..25 and prospectively supported on frozen S1/S2 ranks 26..41.

novel_holdout_selection.selection_rule: all remaining A102 legacy_three_band_gamma_plus records in established canonical order (maximum, compressed_maximizer_contact, witness)

frozen_predictor.condition: N_{j+1}(s) is the exact rank-one numerator of basic_p_{j+1}; D(s) is the common rank-one denominator under the frozen A102 gamma-plus architecture.
frozen_predictor.rule_negative: If D is positive at lower/witness/upper checkpoints, N_{j+1}(witness)>0, and N_{j+1}(lower)<0, predict proper_strict_subcomponent with selected left boundary basic_p_{j+1}.
frozen_predictor.rule_positive: Under the same applicability checks, if N_{j+1}(lower)>0, predict full_segment_coverage.
frozen_predictor.rule_zero: If N_{j+1}(lower)=0, no classification is declared.
frozen_predictor.applicability_failure: If denominator checkpoint signs are not positive or N_{j+1}(witness)<=0, no classification is declared.

primary_adjudication.support_complete_finite_catalogue_rule: All 881 novel ranks are classifiable; every predicted class exactly matches the full exact atlas classification; every predicted partial has exactly one selected internal boundary, on the left, equal to basic_p_{j+1}; and every record passes the existing exact local-stability/certification criteria.
primary_adjudication.refute_structural_rule: Any classifiable rank has an exact class mismatch, or any predicted partial rank has a selected boundary different from left basic_p_{j+1}. One exact mismatch is sufficient.
primary_adjudication.refute_local_stability: Any rank has witness failure or a mathematically certified absence of a nonzero witness-containing strict component under the frozen architecture.
primary_adjudication.inconclusive: Any unclassifiable applicability case, unresolved exact certificate, execution failure, or internal symbolic/direct disagreement without a mathematical counterexample prevents the complete finite-catalogue support verdict.

direct_validation: For every analyzed record, compare exact rank-one condition values with independent direct-matrix exact evaluation at the standard interior checkpoints and every available outside counterexample; any mismatch is reported and blocks support.
no_posthoc_changes: No record deletion/replacement, no rank changes, no endpoint-rule edits, no condition substitution, no tolerance changes, no support/active-band changes, and no rescue classifier after outcomes are inspected.
nonclaims: not an all-M theorem beyond the finite A102 gamma-plus catalogue
not a theorem for architectures outside legacy_three_band_gamma_plus
not beyond the declared A95/A102 source segments
not a proof that nature uses this finite LP architecture
not a physical, spacetime, gravity, or quantum claim
